name: Outlaw Tools v0.6.4
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.6.4

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.6.4

## Optional Own-PC Sync On Windows

- Sign in with Discord in Settings and approve your installations on the Orbital
  Outlaws website. The website stores account/device and expiring connection
  metadata only, never your player-data records or raw game logs.
- Link your own PCs and synchronise supported player records over a direct,
  encrypted connection. Both PCs must be online and directly reachable; there
  is no cloud player-data backup or relay. A blocked connection leaves changes
  safely pending. Linux remains offline/manual-transfer only in this release.
- First linking requires a reviewed source choice and a backup. Overlapping
  inventory is not automatically added together. Conflicting changes are retained
  for review, with per-peer confirmed/pending progress and pause/sign-out controls.
- Retried operations and refinery collection receipts are deduplicated. Local
  observations from game logs remain private; supported derived records can sync.
  Manual player-data export/import remains available without signing in.

## Reliability

- Fixed review routing when a single-lot conflict affects an atomic stock group.
- Bounded sync batches and metadata cleanup reduce memory/SQL pressure during
  large backlogs while mining OCR and game-log catch-up are running.
- Bundles the pinned Windows transport libraries with upstream notices, sources
  and FFmpeg replacement/rebuild instructions.

Physical two-PC/network coverage is still limited. Review the first sync and
retain your backups; do not treat a pending connection as a completed transfer.
